purpose: Durable read-only archive of the data inputs actually used by the Phase B preflight run (2026-08-12), superseding reliance on `git hash-object -w` loose objects alone — those are unreferenced by any commit/tag/ref and are eligible for `git gc` pruning, so they are not a safe long-term identity record on their own. This manifest + the snapshot directory are the durable record.
snapshot_method: plain `cp --no-preserve=links` from each live source path — genuine independent file copies, NOT hard links, NOT git blobs. Files then chmod'd read-only (a-w) after copy.
created_at_context: 2026-08-12, during P0-R1 Phase B closing corrections (second round, per user instruction not to rely on loose objects alone)
aggregate_sha256_definition: sha256 of the sorted (`sort`) output of `sha256sum` run over every file in the snapshot (relative paths, GNU coreutils checksum-line format). Reproducible via the verify command below.
per_file_sha256_listing: research/p0_r1_research_production_identity/data_snapshot_sha256sums.txt (979 lines, `sha256sum`-format, versionable — 154KB, unlike the snapshot itself)

research_base/.original_source: data/research_base/ (gitignored live research input, may change over time — this snapshot pins the 2026-08-12 state)

universe_pool/.original_source: outputs/universe_pool/ (production output, gitignored, grows daily — this snapshot pins only the 3 dates that existed 2026-08-12)

finmind_cache_scores/.original_source: ~/finmind_cache/Scores/*.parquet (production score_store live cache — NOT part of this git repository at all, user home-directory path)

integrity_verification_performed.method: Every one of the 979 copied files was re-hashed post-copy and compared against the sha256 already recorded in preflight.json / scores_cache_blob_manifest.csv (computed from the live source before copying).

rebuild_command_if_snapshot_lost: cp --no-preserve=links outputs/universe_pool/c2_fullpool_2026-08-0{7,}.csv outputs/universe_pool/c2_fullpool_2026-08-1{0,1}.csv research/p0_r1_research_production_identity/data_snapshot/universe_pool/  # or explicitly list the 3 dated files

NOTE: this reproduces the SNAPSHOT MECHANISM, not necessarily identical BYTES — the live sources (data/research_base/, outputs/universe_pool/, ~/finmind_cache/Scores/) can change over time. Byte-identity to THIS 2026-08-12 snapshot can only be confirmed via the verify command below against data_snapshot_sha256sums.txt, which is the actual pinned record.
verify_command: find data_snapshot -type f \( -name '*.parquet' -o -name '*.csv' \) | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
# for a per-file diff instead of just the aggregate:
find data_snapshot -type f \( -name '*.parquet' -o -name '*.csv' \) | sort | xargs sha256sum | diff - data_snapshot_sha256sums.txt
relationship_to_git_blobs: The earlier Phase B run also created `git hash-object -w` loose-object blobs for these same files (blob SHA1s recorded in preflight.json / approval_receipt.json). Those blobs still exist in .git/objects and were NOT removed by this step, but they are not referenced by any branch/tag/commit, so a future `git gc` (or `git gc --prune=now`) could delete them. This snapshot directory + this manifest is now the authoritative durable record for the data inputs; the git blobs are a redundant secondary copy, not the primary one.
